skill.displayName: Shopee-站点大盘数据 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a coherent Shopee data-query integration, but it tells agents to install and update runtime software and CLI packages on the host without clear user control or version pinning.

dimensions.detail: The qhkit CLI dependency fits the purpose, but installing Node into the user home directory, modifying PATH, and suggesting shell startup changes is disproportionate unless handled by the platform or explicitly approved by the user.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact directs runtime bootstrapping with npm global installs, unpinned npx fallback, Node binary download, and qhkit latest upgrades. These are disclosed but overbroad for an analysis skill because they execute remote package code and are not clearly gated by explicit user approval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill includes reasonable limits around required parameters, not guessing missing inputs, avoiding unrelated tools, and capping paid calls, but the trigger wording is somewhat broad for similar site-sales requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not show backdoors or hidden persistence, but global npm installs, user-local Node installation, token configuration, and possible bashrc modification can survive the task and affect later sessions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is narrow: query Shopee site-level market metrics through qhkit, including paid-call disclosure and per-session user approval before consuming credits. That core capability is coherent with the artifact.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable allowing the agent to set up qhkit/Node and configure a Qinghu API token. Prefer a preinstalled, pinned, platform-managed qhkit version, and require explicit approval before any npm, npx, PATH, bashrc, or token-configuration steps. Review paid-credit prompts before allowing calls.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples could cause misrouting, but the body repeatedly scopes the skill to Shopee site-level overview data, so this is a quality concern rather than the main security concern.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The environment-bootstrap instructions are artifact-backed and materially exceed a simple data-query flow because they direct host package installation, runtime setup, and credential configuration during use.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned npx fallback and @latest upgrade path create supply-chain and reproducibility risk for code fetched at runtime.
[RA2] unexpected: The user-local Node installation and PATH changes are real in the artifact; they are not malicious by themselves, but they introduce persistent host changes without clear containment or user-directed approval.
